---
title: Code Annotations (number-lines row width)
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'box\(width: 100% - annote-ln-width\)'
          - 'annotations: \("1": 1\)'
        -
          - 'box\(width: 100%\)\[#ln'
---
